entries.a91ae9ddad33b5cd: The company provides equipment that inspects the appearance of semiconductor package substrates and precision printed circuit boards. Built around an in-house-developed dedicated image-processing computer, the company offers flatbed, roll-to-roll and inline inspection equipment, along with repair equipment for correcting wiring pattern defects, and also provides maintenance services.
entries.b47dab80593094e5: Founded in 1984 as the electronic component assembly company Taiyo Seisakusho, it adopted its current name in 2001.
entries.b90ba073b29f42f0: In response to its withdrawal from the exposure equipment-related business in the fiscal year ended April 2025, the company revised its medium-term management plan and in June 2025 formulated a new medium-term plan with the fiscal year ending April 2028 as its goal. It states that it will work on developing inspection equipment and wiring-pattern defect repair equipment compatible with cutting-edge package substrates, strengthening its earnings structure through appropriate price pass-through and cost reduction, and strengthening sales to overseas markets centered on East Asia.
entries.ba6faf109dd34ad9: Its strength lies in an image processing system built around an in-house-developed dedicated image-processing computer. In July 2025 it launched inspection equipment capable of handling fine patterns with wiring widths and spacing down to 1.5μm, and by combining inspection equipment with defect repair equipment, it provides an integrated solution spanning inspection through repair.

entries.d71d6e2a98d2f02c: Founded in 1984 as the electronic component assembly company Taiyo Seisakusho, it adopted its current name in 2001. Headquartered in Semboku City, Akita Prefecture, it is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of April 30, 2026, the company had 85 employees and conducts business together with 1 Taiwanese subsidiary that is not subject to consolidation.
